study.question: Can removing a fixed total number of first-layer task-tower channels preferentially from auxiliary heads preserve current joint-best click AUC and lower measured prediction cost, compared with the exact-budget removal from the click head?
study.hypothesis: Observation: broad embedding12 and all-tower64/32 reductions scored0.6641111848808231 and0.6654569217074457 versus entry0.666753547526167. The task-residual14/10 allocation later reached0.6671249391761293; auxiliary residual6 fell to0.6669390334913383. Shared auxiliary projection reuse fell to0.6648248738234025; the later source/initialization factorial showed that implementation path was confounded and must not establish that all sharing fails. The present parent scores0.6671410169523699 with315029 dense parameters and32108245 total; three equally wide auxiliary prediction towers remain even though their scorer/item gradients are blocked and only context gradients remain shared. This is an observed allocation, not evidence of redundancy. Mechanism hypothesis: marginal prediction-tower utility is task-dependent; reducing each auxiliary first layer modestly may preserve click information while preserving the full click tower, whereas the exact same total capacity removed from click may be more costly. All four tasks remain trained and predicted. Recent evaluation batching receipts give p50 reference15.23491ms, Dice-only15.11887ms, affine-only15.20880ms and both15.32347ms, with end-to-end times25.18070/24.99136/25.78351/27.59765s. These mixed outcomes do not support universally beneficial batching, so this suite keeps the serial parent. No new architecture or priority claim is made; this is a prospective local capacity-allocation study. Prospectively, for THESE new variants only, click-AUC preservation requires full-population validation candidate-minus-contemporaneous-reference >= -0.0001 AND candidate AUC >= 0.6670410169523699 (archived parent0.6671410169523699 minus0.0001). This does not revise any earlier decision or claim recovery of an unavailable earlier study criterion. All four AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean must be reported; the mean never selects the model. A screening pass remains provisional. Before a preservation claim, target three host-authorized paired seeds and a paired user-cluster 95% bootstrap interval for the AUC difference if that evaluation interface is supplied; otherwise explicitly report the unavailable interval and do not claim statistical noninferiority. Do not change the frozen host seed or scorer in this proposal; later repetitions require the authorized host interface. Prediction-cost utility additionally requires at least2% lower model-only batch-p50 latency versus the contemporaneous reference at the same batch8192, p95 no more than2% worse and end-to-end inference_seconds no more than2% worse. Report throughput, all timing views, training wall/allocated-GPU time, actual parameter counts, examples processed and peak memory; parameter or theoretical MAC reduction alone is not a speedup. Host timing repetition must reproduce the improvement before promotion; if only one timing receipt is available, label utility preliminary. All repeats/controls/diagnostics consume budget.

study.proposed_difference: Only task-tower first-layer widths: reference(click128,auxiliary128 each), auxiliary candidate(128,112), exact-budget click control(80,128), combined candidate(80,112); every second layer64. Construct and initialize the full parent, finish its residual-bank fork_rng scope, then deterministically clone leading rows of first Linear/bias/Dice alpha and BN moments and leading columns of the next Linear. Preserve unchanged Parameter identities and all remaining buffers; discarded weights are not registered or cached. The model code uses no filesystem/network operations and each variant is standalone. The unchanged full template is used only to pair random initialization; this is not trained pruning, distillation or validation-selected channel selection. For tower input widthI and second width64, each removed first-layer channel savesI+66 parameters andI+64 affine MACs. The frozen count identity impliesI=400 and value width112; host must confirm actual counts. This supplies an exactly matched capacity/affine-operation control without weight sharing or a second-layer intervention.
predictions: Directional, unverified: auxiliary-only removal is more likely than the exact-budget click removal to pass the predeclared click-preservation threshold. Equal quality in both cells supports redundancy at this budget, not auxiliary-specific allocation.

Expected analytical total/dense/embedding counts: reference32108245/315029/31793216; each single cell32085877/292661/31793216; both32063509/270293/31793216. Host must measure them. Single cells reduce dense capacity7.10% but total capacity only0.0697%; embeddings dominate storage.

The source-identical shared pathways and retained initial tensors should pass host initialization/masking/state checks. Training trajectories and outputs can differ immediately because removed channels contribute no longer; no forward-equivalence claim.

Smaller tower GEMMs may reduce latency, but embedding/history work and dispatch can dominate. A parameter-count reduction with no measured prediction-cost improvement falsifies utility for this implementation.

Auxiliary AUC/Logloss can change because all heads remain independent and trained. Report all changes, and diagnose click history bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 with counts/positives/negatives using existing fixed bins; other slices are exploratory and require authorized diagnostics.
The combined cell may show nonadditive quality effects through shared context and clipping; compute the predeclared factorial interaction and retain null/negative results.
falsifiers: Any frozen input/history/mask/gradient/optimizer-state or four-output contract failure invalidates the implementation, not the scientific hypothesis.
Click-AUC loss>0.0001 versus the contemporaneous reference or below0.6670410169523699 fails the new preservation gate. No threshold changes after outcomes.

Less than2% model-only p50 reduction, p95 degradation>2%, end-to-end inference degradation>2%, or failure to repeat the cost improvement rejects supported efficiency utility; report isolated single-run improvements as preliminary.

Equal or better click quality from the exact-budget click reduction weakens auxiliary-specific marginal-utility support. Loss in every reduced cell only limits the tested widths, channel subset and initialization.

Substantial seed variation or inability to obtain authorized user-cluster uncertainty prevents a strong preservation/mechanism claim. Repeated seeds alone cannot replace the matched-capacity and factorial contrasts.
